content.text:
**Miraculous Ladybug Season 2 Episode 12 is already out.**

Depending on the episode order you’re using, it may be listed as:

- **“Sapotis”** — shown as Season 2 Episode 12 on the official Miraculous site. ([miraculousladybug.com](https://www.miraculousladybug.com/season-2-episode-12-sapotis/?utm_source=openai))  
- **“Captain Hardrock”** — listed as Season 2 Episode 12 on some platforms/guides. ([watch.plex.tv](https://watch.plex.tv/show/miraculous-tales-of-ladybug-and-cat-noir/season/2/episode/12?utm_source=openai))  

If you mean the **U.S. TV airing**, Rotten Tomatoes lists Season 2 Episode 12 as having aired **May 13, 2018**. ([rottentomatoes.com](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/tv/miraculous_tales_of_ladybug_and_cat_noir/s02/e12?utm_source=openai))

So you should be able to watch it now on whatever service carries *Miraculous* in your region, such as Disney+ or official Miraculous sources.
